purpose: recompute burned-pilot estimability from committed block counts instead of trusting reported estimable booleans
recomputed_invariants: each block test_positive + test_negative equals test_rows
each block train_positive + train_negative equals train_rows
each block training counts equal the complement of the heldout test block
test blocks partition the global applicable/positive/negative counts
block estimability is recomputed from frozen minimum_test_rows, minimum_train_positive and minimum_train_negative
block reasons exactly match the frozen gate failures
reported estimable_blocks equals the recomputed count
recomputed estimable_blocks meets the frozen minimum_estimable_blocks
